description: This source file contains extension methods for buffer writing, providing efficient implementations for writing ReadOnlySequence and ReadOnlySpan<byte> data to IBufferWriter<byte> instances with optimizations for multi-segment buffers.

classes.name: BufferWriterExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for IBufferWriter<byte> to handle writing ReadOnlySequence<byte> and ReadOnlySpan<byte> efficiently.

methods.name: Write<TBufferWriter>(this ref TBufferWriter writer, ReadOnlySequence<byte> input)
methods.description: Writes a ReadOnlySequence<byte> to the buffer writer, segment by segment.

methods.name: Write<TBufferWriter>(ref this TBufferWriter writer, ReadOnlySpan<byte> value)
methods.description: Writes a ReadOnlySpan<byte> to the buffer writer, directly if sufficient space is available, otherwise delegates to multi-segment write.

methods.name: WriteMultiSegment<TBufferWriter>(ref TBufferWriter writer, in ReadOnlySpan<byte> source, Span<byte> destination)
methods.description: Handles writing a ReadOnlySpan<byte> to the buffer writer across multiple segments.
